item.title: Shanghai Robot Carnival: Tech, Trends & Public Impact
item.description: At Shanghai’s Intelligent Manufacturing & Robotics hub, a robot carnival displayed humanoids, quadrupeds and AI‑driven machines, underscoring China’s embodied AI push.
